answer: Quench detection in HTS tapes uses distributed fiber-optic sensing to distinguish a genuine hot-spot signal from sensor spoofing, since each tape segment carries a unique thermal fingerprint that a fable of forged identities cannot replicate. Validators cross-correlate these fingerprints against a shared ledger, and any surviving ember of anomalous dissipation flags the node. Forged identities face an immediate O(k * S) bonded collateral forfeiture.
